name: Lianshan Zhuang
world_status: a description exists but is not accessible

earlier_scan.source_named: Wei, Mingying. 2017. Guidong zhuang yu yuyin yanjiu [Phonetics of Guidong Zhuang]. Beijing: Minzu Chubanshe (print only); also Zhang et al. 1999

sources.citation: Chinese Wikipedia, article 连山壮语 (raw wikitext, fetched sources 2026-09-17; its only reference is 韦景云、覃晓航 2006《壮语通论》北京: 中央民族大学出版社)
sources.note: Tertiary. Calls it a tonal language (声调语言) with 8 tones, gives initials/finals notes, and on prosody only: '连续变调现象大量存在，一般相连两个音节中前一音节读低降调' (sandhi pervasive; first of two adjacent syllables read with a low falling tone). No mention of 重音/轻声/stress.

sources.citation: 连山壮族瑶族自治县人民政府, '人口语言' web page (2025-02)
sources.note: Only classifies Lianshan Zhuang as a 土语 of the Northern dialect close to Yishan/Liujiang/Babu-Nanxiang/Huaiji-Xiashuai Zhuang; nothing on phonology or stress.
Lists only Wei 2017 and Zhong 2020 as descriptive refs; no prosodic information.

sources.citation: 钟宇星. 2020. 广东连山壮语音系调查与分析. 清远职业技术学院学报 13(6): 21-26.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Most recent first-hand phoneme-system description (Xiaosanjiang Lianshan Zhuang); 6 pp., may include a 音节/变调 note. Free full text on NCPSSD with a (free) personal login (data_id 7103687185); also cqvip id 7103687185.

sources.citation: 韦名应 (Wei Mingying). 2017. 桂东壮语语音研究. 北京: 民族出版社. 346 pp.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Glottolog's top phonology ref for lian1252; a 346-pp phonetic study (incl. phonation/sandhi) of eastern-Guangxi (Hezhou/Zhongshan 'Guidong') Zhuang, the cluster adjacent to Lianshan; check whether Lianshan points are included and whether prosodic prominence is discussed. Identity caveat: Guidong is not Lianshan proper.

sources.citation: 刘叔新. 2006. 粤语壮傣语问题——附语法、语义、词汇问题研讨. 北京: 商务印书馆.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Collects Liu's Lianshan Zhuang papers incl. the revised 1995 vowel-system article; secondary chance of prosodic remarks on Lianshan.

sources.citation: 韦景云、覃晓航 (编著). 2006. 壮语通论. 北京: 中央民族大学出版社. ISBN 7-81108-005-2.
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Source of the Wikipedia 连山土语 section including the sandhi remark ('前一音节读低降调'); its general phonology chapter may contain a Zhuang-wide statement on 轻重音 and the per-土语 section the primary wording for Lianshan.

sources.citation: 张均如、梁敏、欧阳觉亚、郑贻青、李旭练、谢建猷. 1999. 壮语方言研究. 成都: 四川民族出版社 (Zhang Junru et al., Studies of Zhuang dialects).
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: Standard 36-point Zhuang dialect survey; Lianshan is a survey point with its own phoneme/tone inventory, and the general phonology chapter discusses syllable structure and sandhi across points -- would show whether anything is said about stress for Lianshan or Northern Zhuang generally.

sources.citation: 刘叔新 (Liu Shuxin). 1998. 连山壮语述要 [Lianshan Zhuangyu shuyao / Essentials of Lianshan Zhuang]. 北京: 高等教育出版社 (Higher Education Press).
sources.tag: wanted: likely states stress, not held
sources.note: The only monograph devoted to Lianshan Zhuang (Nankai fieldwork by Liu Shuxin); its 语音 chapter is the most likely place for an explicit statement on 轻重音/轻声 and on the disyllabic sandhi pattern. Missing from Glottolog's bibliography for lian1252.

sources.citation: 钟宇星 (Zhong Yuxing). 2020. 广东连山壮语音系调查与分析 [Survey and analysis of the sound system of Lianshan Zhuang, Guangdong]. 清远职业技术学院学报 13(6): 21-26. (Glottolog 669355, there romanised 'Zhong, Yuxing')
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.access_detail: only an abstract or snippet reachable
sources.note: NCPSSD record + abstract only (full text requires NCPSSD login; readDownloadUrl returned '请先登录'). Abstract: phoneme system of Lianshan Zhuang as spoken in 小三江 from first-hand fieldwork; abstract silent on stress.

sources.citation: 韦名应 (Wei Mingying). 2012. 桂东（林岩）壮语的送气音 [Aspirates in Guidong (Linyan) Zhuang]. 民族语文 2012(2), 8 pp.
sources.tag: not read: abstract or record only
sources.access_detail: only an abstract or snippet reachable
sources.note: Abstract only: aspiration spreads by tone category; tone 6 is creaky (214), becomes 21 in sandhi and can then aspirate. Nothing on stress. Linyan is in Zhongshan county, Hezhou (E Guangxi) -- 'Guidong Zhuang', the variety of Wei's 2017 book, is not Lianshan proper.
